title: RWB-S6-E5023: the eligibility slice has no C row for its four consumed rows, no DP-04 row and no requirement id

description: (1) The plan gives H = RWB-S6-E5023-CON, RWB-PLT-E1027-CON and RWB-PLT-N001-CON and C, I, X = None, while the step reads the rwb-case case list and answers the case move, reads the COLLINS score of rwb-source-data and reads the DEBTSALE package of rwb-decision, so four consumed rows exist in fact and none in the metadata. proposed: Keep the metadata rows exactly as the plan states them, declare the four consumed rows in 12.2 with the operation-name placeholder and the fakes of 12.8, read the DEBTSALE package as data on the owner's read rather than claiming a kit, and trace REQ-S6-001 from the FSD

source: Template and Rules v1 R5.4, R5.5, R7.3 and R9; WP B-S6-01 story lines RWB-S6-E5023-APP and RWB-S6-E5023-CON (H, C, I, X); Architecture v5 Text Extract v1 slides 19, 41, 43 and 45; TSD S6 Debt sale v2 T5.3 and T-A; legacy RWB-E5-023

proposed: Declare no event at this step and no consumed event, keep the H row as the plan states it, and record RWB-PLT-TE006-CON as the wave 0 library the service's topic and the award and transfer stories need

title: RWB-S6-E5023: the 54 percent cap named in legacy AC1 is carried by R-DS-19, whose criterion and test belong to RWB-S6-E6005-APP
source: Template and Rules v1 R7.3 and R9; legacy RWB-E5-023 AC1; FSD S6 Debt sale v3 A2.1.1, A2.1.3.1, A2.16 and Requirements served; Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 rows R-DS-01 and R-DS-19; TSD S6 Debt sale v2 T4; Architecture v5 Text Extract v1 slide 22
description: Legacy AC1 says the step applies the eligibility rules 'including the 54 percent cap' to pick the sale population, and the FSD keeps the same sentence. R-DS-01, the row that selects the accounts from the case list, carries only 'eligibility rule passes and deviation_open = none'; the only row of the 41 that tests the cap is R-DS-19 at BIDS_RECEIVED, 'Test the price against the reserve and the 54 percent cap, and route the award', and FSD FEAT-DBS-16 'Apply the debt sale cap' is an E6 feature. The cap test is therefore RWB-S6-E6005-APP's and this story proves the eligibility selection and records the cap value with its version instead.
evidence: legacy RWB-E5-023 AC1; FSD S6 A2.1.1 and A2.1.3.1 R-DS-01 row; Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 R-DS-01 and R-DS-19; FSD S6 A1.2 row FEAT-DBS-16 'Apply the debt sale cap' with epic E6; Temporal and Drools Design Text Extract v1 slide 22 notes (Debt sale route set, 41 rules)
proposed: Record the cap as a rule fact of the DEBTSALE package read with its version, keep the legacy words in AC1 unchanged, and read R-DS-19 and its criterion as RWB-S6-E6005-APP's

title: RWB-S6-E5024: no source gives the minimum lot size, the reserve basis, the payment-terms ladder or the buyer-class rule, and LOV-LOT-STATUS has no priced value while SCR-25 declares a priced state
source: Template and Rules v1 R7.3 and R9; TSD S6 Debt sale v2 T3.1, T3.2 and T4; FSD S6 Debt sale v3 A2.2.2, A2.2.3.1 (BR-S6-002) and Screens (SCR-25 'Select accounts, build lots, set the reserve and send for approval'); Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 rows R-DS-04 and R-DS-05; legacy RWB-E5-024 (Screen and states: 'Draft; priced; approved'); Architecture v5 Text Extract v1 slide 19
description: R-DS-05 tests account_count against a minimum lot size and R-DS-04 proposes a reserve, tiered buyer terms and a buyer class, and FSD S6 BR-S6-002 requires every such value to be reference data with a version. No source states the minimum lot size, the basis of the reserve or the selling price, the payment-terms ladder or the class rule, so the build reads them and their values stay missing rather than invented. Separately, the legacy screen SCR-25 declares the states Draft, priced and approved while LOV-LOT-STATUS carries BUILDING, OFFERED, AWARDED, TRANSFERRED and CLOSED and no PRICED value, so the priced state is carried by the decision record and the case route state and the lot stays BUILDING until the committee approval sets OFFERED.
evidence: TSD S6 T3.2 LOV-LOT-STATUS (BUILDING, OFFERED, AWARDED, TRANSFERRED, CLOSED) and LOV-BUYER-CLASS (AMC, NON_AMC); TSD S6 T3.1 DF-SAL-024 reserve_price, DF-SAL-029 payment_terms and DF-SAL-036 selling_price with no basis; FSD S6 BR-S6-002; legacy RWB-E5-024 Screen and states ('SCR-25 Lot builder | Draft; priced; approved'); Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 R-DS-05 condition 'account_count below the minimum lot size'
area: Reference data, rule values and screen state
proposed: Read the minimum lot size, the reserve and selling-price basis, the payment-terms ladder and the buyer-class rule as versioned reference data or rule rows, leave their values as missing until rwb-decision and the product owner publish them, and carry the priced state on the decision record and the case route state instead of a non-existent lot status
